description: This PHP source file defines a Schedule class responsible for managing scheduled tasks in the OrangeHRM's console command scheduling system. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and managing tasks, along with handling task uniqueness and scheduling logic.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Manages scheduling of tasks, allowing addition, retrieval, and filtering of tasks based on due status, and ensuring task ID uniqueness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Schedule with console and output interfaces.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task based on command info, ensuring it is not the 'orangehrm:run-schedule' command, and assigns a unique ID.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Replaces the current list of tasks with a new array of tasks.

methods.name: getDueTasks
methods.description: Retrieves tasks that are due based on the specified timezone.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a task based on the command name, ensuring no duplicates within current tasks.
